newsitem.title: FRANCE: Three French climbers presumed dead.
newsitem.headline: Three French climbers presumed dead.

text.p: Search parties on Les Courtes, a mountain in the Mont Blanc range, have given up hope of finding three French climbers alive.

Rescuers found a canteen, a crampon and an ice axe that belonged to the trio and concluded that the climbers, two men and a woman who have been missing for four days, had fallen into a crevasse, police said on Wednesday.
More than 40 people have died in accidents in the Alps in the last two weeks.
